modules.module_title: Take Charge of the Shift from knotting machine operator

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work place
check for the necessary items like gum tape, knotting comb and knotting brush, knife etc.

meet the previous shift knotting machine operator& discuss with him/ her regarding the issues faced by them with respect to the quality, production, machine, safety or any other specific instruction etc.
check the run outs for his/ her shift.
check whether any sort change program is there for the said run outs
check the availability of the beams and accordingly inform the same to the higher authority
check the availability of the knotting needles required for the running counts of the running beams
check the condition of the knotting stand, knotting machine, knotting needles etc.
take over the shift from the outgoing operator in a proper manner

modules.module_title: Handing over the Shift to knotting machine operator

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming knotting machine operator in a proper manner & get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot

report to his/ her shift superiors as well as that of the incoming shift, in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for work, in such a case, the shift has to be properly handed over to the incoming shift superior and get clearance sought from him/ her, before leaving the work spot

report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues or any other issue faced in his/ her shift, and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superiors
ensure the work place is clean

modules.module_title: Mounting of Beams on the Looms

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the loom is stopped with warp just enough (around 2-3 meters) for knotting
report to the higher authority if the loom is stopped with excess warp
when the knotting has to be carried out in the looms with twin beams (in most of the cases), ensure that there is no difference in the left out warp meters
correct the dropper crossing (if any)
check whether any ends are left out in the run out beams, particularly near the selvedges and bring the same to the knowledge of the higher authority and act as per his/ her instructions
check the condition of the reed on the loom in the selvedge sides for any deviation, the same has to be brought to the knowledge of the higher authority and act as per his/ her advice
check whether any bead formation is there in the droppers. if so, the same has to be removed/cleaned

check the condition of the beams for the beam fault like soft size, size patches, shade variation etc. the same has to be brought to the knowledge of the higher authority and act as per his/ her advice
cut the old warp leaving only 2-3 meters of warp length required for knotting
cover the left warp with card board or polythene sheet or with hope sack if the qty left out due to beam complaint is more as per the advice of the higher authority
remove the cut/ empty beams from the loom shed and transport to the place where they have to be stored
clean the loom and all the places thoroughly, as advised by the supervisor
check whether the fresh beams are properly covered with paper, card board or polyethene sheet to avoid any damage during handling

check the loom card for following to ascertain the fresh beams to be loaded: warp count, total ends, set no., beam no.s ( for the opposite sides), beam meters ( there should not be any difference in meters).
bring the fresh beams from the place they are stored to the loom, where knotting has to be carried out

check the condition of the fresh beams after removing the beam wrappers, for transit damages; in case of the same it has to be brought to the notice of the higher authorities. the fresh beam has to be checked faults like sunken ends, soft size, size patches, etc.; further action can be carried out as per the advice of the higher authority only.
mount the fresh beams on the loom carefully without causing damage to the raw material, beams, machine, or for any individual, including himself or herself
ensure beam alignment in case of twin beams
ensure no cross ends in the old warp. a group of not more than 100 ends can be taken & brushed properly
check for the sizing tapes in the fresh beams
cut the fresh warp in the second tape
bring the fresh warp to the knotting stand without any cross ends using knotting comb
correct the cross ends in the old warp also using knotting comb, before bringing the same to the knotting stand
dress the warp sheet carefully without giving room for cross ends or cut ends etc
weigh the knotting waste & the same has to be recorded in the knotting entry note
tie the thrums (sufficient enough till the run out) on the loom neatly.
collect the knotting waste & store in the place earmarked
use the needle that is earmarked for the beams mounted

check the machine & the needle by doing few knots. for any deviation, bring the same to the notice of the higher authority. do the knotting of the beams in the speed as advised by the higher authority
check for double end, knot slippage etc. through close monitoring of the performance of the knotting
remove the knotting machine from the stand
remove the knotting stand from the knotted loom, collect the waste and to get the same stored in the place earmarked
apply the beam locks (if any) & to see that the knotted beams are in tight condition so as to run the machine without any problem till the knots reach the droppers zone
bring the knots out of the droppers, heald wires, reed etc., without any breakage of warp ends
draw the broken warp ends
ensure proper functioning of the warp stop motion
apply colour cone to ensure that no double end is left out on the fabric
see that the extra ends are routed through extra ends clips& wound properly in the extra ends bobbin
see that the roll is doffed properly
see that the doffed roll is removed from the loom and brought to the place earmarked
